probe.description: Repo-relative path to an executable probe script

args.description: Probe argument vector. {featureDir}, {repoRoot}, {featureRepoRoot}, {slug}, {node}, {baseSha} are engine-substituted placeholders; no other placeholder is legal. May be empty.

expects.description: Exact expected probe answer token. No '|' alternation -- declare separate edges instead.

phasePath.description: A path or argument phase-entry.sh / phase-exit.sh resolves at call time. Placeholders: {docs} (the feature's docs directory, docs/loop-spec/features/<slug>), {featureDir}, {root} (the repository root, or the workspace root in workspace mode), {slug}, {spec} (artifacts.spec or {docs}/SPEC.md), {tasks} (artifacts.tasks or {featureDir}/tasks.json), {f:<dotted.key>} (that feature.json value). No other placeholder is legal.

phaseIngress.description: What lib/phase-entry.sh lists when the phase opens: the feature.json keys its packet carries and the files it reads. Only a phase agent node (body skills/<id>/SKILL.md) may declare it.

fields.description: feature.json keys (dotted paths allowed) the packet carries; absent ones read null

writer.description: The phase that should have written the file, named in the FLAG when it is absent

template.description: A file under skills/shared/artifact-templates/; the driver's phase-begin writes it to path when path is absent, with the facts it holds filled

skeletons.description: Artifacts the driver writes in the shape the exit gates accept before the phase opens (lib/graph/driver.py phase-begin)

body.description: Repo-relative .sh script, the same shape as a gate node body

when.description: Run only when this feature.json key (dotted path) reads as this string; absent means always

phaseEgress.description: What lib/phase-exit.sh checks and records when the phase closes, in the order listed here. Only a phase agent node may declare it; a phase node without one has no exit gate (DELIVER: its terminal states are observation-only).

misplaced.description: Artifact file name under {docs} to look for in the repository's other checkouts when it is absent here

required.description: Files whose absence is a FLAG [label] <path> missing

gates.description: Deterministic checks, run in order; a non-zero exit relays the body's findings as FLAG [label] lines

oracle.description: When a supervisor is the run's oracle, the phase must have put a question to it

writes.description: feature.json paths (by prefix) the phase may change between entry and exit; the egress guard names any other

artifactsIfPresent.description: artifacts.<key> pointers recorded on ok only when the file exists

artifactsDefault.description: artifacts.<key> values recorded on ok only when the key is still null

onOk.description: Scripts run after every gate passed and before the commit (EXECUTE's at-end squash); a non-zero exit is a FLAG

commit.description: Single-repo commit of the listed paths that exist; workspace mode keeps them local

checkpoint.description: Checkpoint tag name recorded on ok (lib/checkpoint.sh tag)

set.description: feature.json keys reset on ok, each to the JSON value given

close.description: always: ok appends the phase to completedPhases and clears the team; terminal: only with --terminal (ITERATE's rewind pass leaves the phase open)

label.description: Short human-facing name used in step descriptors and graph readers

optionalReads.description: State keys the node consults but that are legitimately absent or null (an opt-out the schema documents, e.g. verificationBaseline without LOOP_SPEC_STARTUP_BASELINE=1). Entering the node never asserts them; the body owns the null case. A key may appear in reads or optionalReads, never both.

skill.description: The skill the cycle invokes to run this agent node when it is not `loop-spec:<id>`: the driver prints `EXT skill=<name>` under NEXT and the cycle skill invokes `Skill(loop-spec:<name>)`. The spec node names the lite candidate skill so the short route never loads the full SPEC body (orchestrator-port-followup-3.md, N4).

bodyArgs.description: Argument vector passed to a function/gate body. {featureDir}, {repoRoot}, {featureRepoRoot}, {slug}, {node}, {baseSha} are engine-substituted placeholders; no other placeholder is legal. Absent means the body is invoked with no arguments.

admit.description: Human-node pause gate (contract sec 4): admitted on entry writes a checkpoint and pauses; not admitted (including unresolved) skips the node. Only a human node may declare it.

ingress.description: The phase's entry packet, read by lib/phase-entry.sh

egress.description: The phase's exit gate, run by lib/phase-exit.sh

routeDefault.description: Node id to take when this node has route edges and none is satisfied. Absent means no-route is an abort, never a silent chain fallthrough (contract sec 3).

sameSession.description: true: the agent node this edge enters starts in the session that closed the previous phase (cycle-driver.sh next answers NEXT instead of HANDOFF). Absent or false: one phase per invocation. Read through non-agent nodes between two phases.
